description: Optional: you don't need it, create_app asks for approval by itself the first time you publish. Asks the person for approval without publishing anything (agent is your name, like "Claude Code"). Returns url, code, pollKey and message. Take the person to url yourself: open it in their browser if you can (open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux, start on Windows, or navigate there if you have a browser); if you can't, show them the link in one line in the language of the conversation. Then call connect_status with pollKey and carry on by yourself as soon as it's approved, without asking the person to type anything. Never put pollKey in an app.

agent.description: Your name as the person knows you (e.g. "Claude Code", "Codex", "ChatGPT").

name: connect
